story.label: Opening
story.value: Sea spray freezes along the landing ropes. Turf roofs and carved prows shelter beneath the basalt cliffs.

story.label: The request
story.value: Gendry brings the work to the party through Sea Wolf Clans. Gendry secretly gathers information for a faction or local ruler.
story.source: dossier-story.ts v2; stored templates + explicit record links

story.label: First expedition
story.value: Begin at Caverns of the Buried Beast. Examine the unworked ledger recording the trade route. Examine the rain-spoiled survey rolls recording the abandoned store. Examine the salvaged correspondence recording the district's safe passage. Each section has its own holder and marked threshold. The other listed sites are additional jobs in the same region.
story.source: dossier-story.ts v2; stored templates + explicit record links

story.label: Stakes
story.value: The local faction wants the work completed before rivals can claim its outcome. Failure leaves the claim unsettled; success gives the party a result they can bring back and defend.
story.source: dossier-story.ts v2; stored templates + explicit record links

story.label: At the table
story.value: The associated encounters use the listed reaction rolls. Treasure is allocated to the listed sites, but its discovery and access still need to be resolved in play. Tarot meanings are prompts; they do not add an unlisted power or compel an outcome.
story.source: Published dossier assembly and play policy

reading.description: A signpost points in many directions at a crossroads. The Crossroads card warns of a difficult but necessary decision.
reading.meaning: A place that constrains movement, such as a narrow ravine or passage.

faction.name: Andrik Freeholders
faction.asset: Valley farms, fishing fleets, and smokehouses
faction.agenda: Safeguard livestock and grain stores against raiders, trolls, and the freezing sea spray.

entry.description: Scroll of the Covenant, 3 Divine Halo blessings (840 gp)

items: Scroll of the Covenant, 3 Divine Halo blessings (840 gp)

reading.title: OOZE
reading.description: A gelatinous cube with various items suspended inside it creeps through a vaulted sewer. The Ooze card indicates the importance of something that seems lowly or innocuous.
reading.meaning: A treasure that is valuable but not beautiful, such as a poorly crafted piece of jewelry incorporating precious stones.

entry.description: Silver torc with a sapphire and two pearls (360 gp)

items: Silver torc with a sapphire and two pearls (360 gp)

reading.title: PUZZLE
reading.description: An elaborate puzzle box floats in the air, glowing from within. The Puzzle card speaks to intelligence and strategic thinking.
reading.meaning: A brilliant creature that relies on careful plans and tactics rather than brute strength, or a trap that can be bypassed by solving a puzzle or riddle.

reading.title: VOID
reading.description: An endless void seems to spiral toward a central hole that devours all. This card spells disaster.
reading.meaning: A skeleton, zombie, or similar Undead remnant of a living creature; alternatively, a trap that’s broken and nonfunctional.

reading.title: SUN
reading.description: A sun blazes brightly in the summer sky. The Sun card brings hope—either well-founded or deluded.
reading.meaning: An angel or a similar creature that embodies hope and good.

reading.title: RING
reading.description: An emerald ring glows within a decorative jewelry box. The Ring card suggests both a promise and the honor involved in keeping it.
reading.meaning: A situation complicated by a person’s promise to do something.
